targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-1007 (2026-09-07, evidence-purpose PASS, MECH-536 primary + MECH-535 read-across) is the eval-time action-persistence discriminator MECH-536's own notes name. Its verdict grid returned PASS / supports on both claims, but the run is NON-ADJUDICABLE and the direction is re-stamped non_contributory for BOTH claims, for one reason the driver itself recorded and its grid never consulted: the pre-registered C2 non-degeneracy check FAILED (manifest non_degenerate: false, reason 'C2: on some cycle-present seed a verdict arm did not both outlive greedy AND visit >= 3 more cells'). On the single cycle-present seed (42 of 42/43/44; greedy cycle_incidence 0.80/0.00/0.00) the persist_k2 verdict arm converted the period-2 cycle into a period-4 orbit on 70% of episodes (bounded_orbit_incidence 0.70, period histogram {4:14}) and visited 6.05 mean unique cells against a required 7.45 (greedy 4.45 + 3), so its 'competence flat' (0.10 vs 0.00 res/ep) measured no foraging exposure -- exactly the lengthened-lethal-orbit case the driver's red-team F3 named. C1 on a k=2 latch is satisfied by construction (the period-2 detector is silent on period-4 by design), so for persist_k2 both load-bearing criteria are true regardless of direction. persist_k4 is NOT a clean reading either (red-team finding 1, confirmed): it clears the opportunity test by 0.10 cells (7.55 vs 7.45; per-episode unique-cells SD 2.06, so ~0.2 SE) while 9/20 of its seed-42 episodes are 200-step wall-presses (stationary fraction 0.84-0.98, 87% of the arm's 2071 steps) and the other 11 die at 19-37 steps -- stupor plus early death, which is exactly MECH-536's predicted 'straight runs into the boundary' signature, so its C2 non-degeneracy pass is a coin-flip margin, not foraging exposure. The deeper design tension: MECH-536 PREDICTS perseveration into the boundary, while the pre-registered non-degeneracy test requires the latched agent to move through >= 3 more cells; if the claim is true, C2 non-degeneracy is hard to satisfy by construction, and the exposure DV must change, not only the gating. Either way n=1 cycle-present seed cannot carry a claim verdict. The indexer already scores this correctly (scoring_excluded: degenerate); the write corrects the manifest's PASS/supports stamp so the record matches. MECH-535: the seed-42 cycle is a scalar-identical (competence, survival) re-observation of 978's exemplar on 3/3 seeds, not independent evidence; the phenotype DISTRIBUTION on the scored DV -- 1 cycle seed (0.80) / 2 stupor seeds (fixed_point 1.0) of 3 -- is recorded here for the first time (978's exemplar was a 12-rollout fishtank on seed 42 only) and becomes the owed independent replication only once a successor pre-screens fresh seeds. Two recorded, non-gating findings the successor must carry: (i) C3 FAILED -- the same k=2 latch on the good-representation anchor retained ~12% of local_view_greedy (5.63 vs 48.05 res/ep), so the 'protective, not necessary' framing needs a 'costly on a good representation' caveat; (ii) the stochastic_sample comparator EXCEEDED the random-walk envelope on 3/3 seeds (2.05/1.70/1.90 vs random_walk 1.05/0.90/0.85; per 100 survived steps 3.09/2.36/2.99 vs 2.18/2.11/1.80) -- the reading the grid would have called a gating deficit had a verdict arm produced it; whether that rise is direction recovered from the logits or exploration opportunity is unposed by this design. Failure-location: MEASURES (test-design defect in the verdict grid), not chargeable to REE. No substrate hold; epistemic_category standard on both. Routing: /queue-experiment, same-question letter V3-EXQ-1007a with (1) the verdict grid gating on non-degeneracy, (2) an exposure DV that separates 'straight run then press' from 'lengthened orbit' (pooled non-stationary step fraction and cells traversed vs random_walk's per-step coverage, margin pre-registered above the per-episode SE; fixed-point caveat on pooled stationary fraction, not episode count), (3) the verdict k chosen by a per-k orbit-histogram reach check (the k=2 period-4 orbit is a generic latch artifact: local_view_greedy_persist_k2 orbits on 60-80% of episodes of a policy with zero orbits unlatched; k3 is untested), with the good-representation anchor latched at the SAME k so C3 is measured at the verdict k, (4) >= 2 cycle-present seeds via a greedy pre-screen, (5) a stochastic_sample_persist_k arm and a pre-registered reading for the comparator. C3 CAVEAT (user-ratified for MECH-536's note now, not deferred): the same k=2 latch on the good-representation anchor cut competence ~8x (local_view_greedy 45.75/49.7/48.7 -> local_view_greedy_persist_k2 5.75/3.45/7.7 res/ep; retention 0.126/0.069/0.158 vs the 0.50 bar), so 'protective, not necessary' carries 'costly at fixed depth on a good representation' until C3 is re-measured at the successor's verdict k.

learning_extracted: A pre-registered non-degeneracy check that the verdict grid does not GATE on is decorative: this driver computed non_degenerate=false correctly and then returned PASS/supports anyway. The indexer's degeneracy guard caught it downstream (scoring_excluded), but pending_review.md lists an evidence-purpose non_degenerate:false PASS under 'PASS (verify & close)' with no flag, because the adjudication flag only fires for diagnostic/baseline runs -- a discovery-net gap, not only a driver gap.

A k=2 latch on a period-2 argmax alternation yields a period-4 orbit by construction -- AND the period-4 orbit is a GENERIC latch artifact on any greedy-on-gradient policy: local_view_greedy_persist_k2 orbits on 60-80% of episodes (histogram {4: 16/16/12}) on a policy with zero orbits unlatched. persist_k2 cannot be a verdict arm, and k3's orbit behaviour is untested (k4 happened to break it: {none: 20}).

The pre-registered non-degeneracy test (survive longer AND +3 unique cells) cannot separate 'straight run then boundary press' from 'lengthened lethal orbit': persist_k4 on seed 42 cleared it by 0.10 cells while 87% of its steps were 200-step wall-press. Worse, MECH-536 PREDICTS perseveration into the boundary, so a true claim makes the opportunity test hard to satisfy by construction. The exposure DV must change (pooled non-stationary steps, cells traversed vs random_walk per-step coverage, margin > SE), not only the gating.

The 978 ambitendency phenotype is seed-specific (1/3 cycle-present); a 3-seed design conditioned on cycle presence has n=1 by expectation. A successor must select or add seeds so >= 2 are cycle-present, or the verdict rests on one seed however the arms behave.

The stochastic comparator exceeded the undirected envelope on 3/3 seeds while both latches stayed inside it. That is a real signal outside the gate: either the logits carry recoverable direction that sampling exploits (gating-deficit-like) or sampling simply buys exploration coverage (26 unique cells vs 4-9). The successor must pre-register which, e.g. a stochastic_sample_persist_k4 arm and a per-survived-step competence DV.

C3 FAILED: the same k=2 latch on the good-representation anchor cut competence ~8x (48.05 -> 5.63 res/ep). Persistence is not merely 'not necessary' on a good representation; at k=2 it is costly. MECH-536's framing needs that caveat regardless of the verdict.

Route: /queue-experiment same-question letter V3-EXQ-1007a (implementation fix + re-posed exposure DV, not a new scientific question): (1) verdict grid gates on non_degenerate -- degenerate C2 returns non_contributory, never PASS; (2) exposure DV separating straight-run-then-press from lengthened orbit: pooled non-stationary step fraction + cells traversed vs random_walk's per-step coverage, margin pre-registered above the per-episode SE (unique_cells SD ~2.1); fixed-point caveat on pooled stationary fraction; (3) verdict k chosen by a per-k orbit-histogram reach check with an explicit 'k orbits -> arm reported only' branch (k2 excluded; k3 untested; k4 broke the orbit here), and local_view_greedy_persist_k at the verdict k so C3 is measured where the verdict is; (4) >= 2 cycle-present seeds via a cheap greedy pre-screen over more seeds; (5) keep switch_cost and stochastic_sample, add stochastic_sample_persist_k, pre-register the comparator's reading; (6) carry the C3 caveat.
